w4b_required_factor: Producer-owned semantic DAG and exact authority/provenance identity
why_mandatory: Meaning must remain owned by its producer even when physical carriers change.
failure_if_ignored: Physical integration silently becomes semantic reownership.

w4b_required_factor: PRE-V3 actor-independent world != V3 developmental/actor runtime
why_mandatory: Empirical/structural possibility and actor-indexed realization are different jurisdictions.
failure_if_ignored: Population evidence is mistaken for belief/personhood or V3 state.

w4b_required_factor: Information-equivalent reconstructibility, not mandatory eager persistence
why_mandatory: Trii's information theorem survived Chetiri's challenge to D15 physical necessity.
failure_if_ignored: Historical persistence choice is fossilized as architecture law.

why_mandatory: W35 retains persistent/virtual/hybrid and seam/continuous-DAG forks as OPEN.
failure_if_ignored: W4B invents closure by synthesis rather than authority.

why_mandatory: VALID_EMPTY, UNRESOLVED, BLOCKED, NONCOMPARABLE, UNDERPOWERED, OBSERVED_ZERO and missing are noncollapsible.
failure_if_ignored: Absence or partial search is converted into false negative truth.

why_mandatory: Semantic relation, source identity, respondent composability, measurement, structural admission, and actor effects are distinct.
failure_if_ignored: One authority surface is widened across incompatible operations.

why_mandatory: Depth>1 recursion must use exact public role-bearing discovered-child handoff; caller reconstruction is forbidden.
failure_if_ignored: Recursive topology becomes unreplayable/private or silently rematched.

why_mandatory: Projection/scalarization requires complete governed component coverage and unanimous nonempty authority.
failure_if_ignored: Generic carrier capacity or majority becomes semantic authority.

why_mandatory: A complete evaluator over supplied queries is not an autonomous discovery controller.
failure_if_ignored: W4B assumes I05 completeness means full originary fracture-map recovery.

w4b_required_factor: Exact exhaustive vs adaptive partial discovery separation
why_mandatory: Adaptive exploration may schedule only between sealed exact units and cannot emit global negative.
failure_if_ignored: Exploratory truncation corrupts exact discovery semantics.

why_mandatory: Candidate, evidence, adjudication, revision, seal, promotion, current selection, rollback and invalidation are distinct; no latest lane.
failure_if_ignored: Newest/prototype artifacts self-promote or history is rewritten.

why_mandatory: Joint N, ordered component denominators, V551 projection ownership and relation-evidence authority role must survive downstream.
failure_if_ignored: Downstream consumers re-infer sign, scalarize denominators, or accept role-erased carriers.

why_mandatory: Explicit specificity walkback remains empirical possibility; proxy != exact fact != actor belief.
failure_if_ignored: Proxy evidence becomes individual prediction or structural/actor truth.

why_mandatory: Preserve full authority/function capital and exact unresolved obligations before choosing architecture or retiring carriers.
failure_if_ignored: Successful repair prototypes erase still-needed historical capital or are promoted merely to close preservation.

why_mandatory: Z05 closes bounded lineage/restart semantics but not complete source/compiler coverage or topology ranking.
failure_if_ignored: One reference graph is generalized into whole-machine closure.

w4b_required_factor: Currentness and authority are not chronology
why_mandatory: Recovered historical denominators and branch tips remain historical unless explicitly selected current.
failure_if_ignored: Older/larger recovered carriers resurrect as present authority.

why_mandatory: Fracture-map readmission, WVS7 certification, and some runtime courts are suspended, not rejected or abandoned.
failure_if_ignored: Unfinished campaigns disappear from the design frontier.

why_mandatory: Child repairs can close prerequisites while the parent architecture question remains OPEN/RETURN_REQUIRED.
failure_if_ignored: A sequence of local PASS results is misreported as final PRE-V3 architecture.
